# antares

> antares is a spec-driven project whose validated source of truth lives in doc/arch; specs come first and code follows.

spec-first: doc/arch is the source of truth — run `speckit status` then `speckit next` and read the spec before writing any code.

## Documentation

- [Agent context](AGENTS.md): dense LLM context
- [Human overview](README.md): approachable overview
- [Spec corpus](doc/arch/): the validated source of truth

## Where things live

- `doc/arch/memory/constitution.md` — doctrines and principles
- `doc/arch/adr/` — decisions, `0013` HTTP, `0017` API client, `0018` Linux I/O
- `src/ports/io/io_engine.hpp` — the kernel I/O port
- `src/adapters/platform/io/engine_base.cpp` — op table, timers and the resolver
- `src/adapters/platform/io/kqueue_engine.cpp` — Darwin engine
- `src/adapters/platform/io/io_uring_engine.cpp` — Linux engine, preferred
- `src/adapters/platform/io/epoll_engine.cpp` — Linux fallback
- `src/ports/http/client.hpp` — the HTTP client port
- `src/adapters/http/client.cpp` — pool, redirects, retries
- `src/adapters/http/connection.cpp` — TLS over memory BIOs
- `src/adapters/http/h2_session.cpp` — nghttp2 framing and streams
- `src/domain/http/` — request, response, url, retry, sse, websocket
- `src/domain/k8s/` — path, options, status, watch frame, kubeconfig
- `src/domain/json/value.hpp` — the JSON reader the API client rests on
- `src/domain/yaml/node.hpp` — the YAML subset a kubeconfig needs
- `src/domain/k8s/discovery.hpp` — group and resource descriptors
- `src/domain/k8s/exec_channel.hpp` — the exec channel framing
- `src/ports/k8s/kube_client.hpp` — the Kubernetes client port
- `src/adapters/k8s/http_kube_client.cpp` — the port over the HTTP client
- `tools/k8s_live/main.cpp` — the read-only live smoke
- `tests/k8s/conformance.cpp` — the API client suite
- `tests/http/conformance.cpp` — the HTTP client suite
- `tests/io/conformance.cpp` — the engine suite
- `doc/arch/quality/quality-scenarios.md` — quality scenarios
- `doc/arch/threat-model/threat-model.md` — STRIDE threats and mitigations
- `doc/arch/threat-model/privacy-threat-model.md` — privacy threats
- `doc/arch/observability/observability.md` — signals and cardinality

## Contracts and configuration

Exit codes are stable and small, and `--json` emits one object. Configuration
families in play: `architecture`, `hygiene`, `project`, `guard`, `context`.

## Layers

Language mode is C++26 with CMake 4.4 as the floor. Layers run inward: `domain`,
`application`, `ports`, `adapters`; `src/platform` is the only OS root.

The engine owns a dedicated loop pool, one thread each, plus one resolver thread, so
no call blocks the loop. Work is bound to a loop for its life; no lock guards
connection state. Timers run on the engine, so a delay costs no thread. Tests wait
on completions, never on a clock.

Backends: kqueue on Darwin; io_uring then epoll then poll on Linux.

HTTP client: TLS 1.2+ through memory BIOs with ALPN offering h2 then HTTP/1.1,
multiplexing with the peer's stream ceiling, GOAWAY retry, keep-alive, bearer/basic
and mTLS credentials, chunked streaming with an idle timeout, SSE and WebSocket.

Kubernetes client: a path value type validated as DNS-1123, list options rendered
as a query, `Status` mapped to a typed reason, watch frames split across chunks,
a kubeconfig parsed from a YAML subset, and credentials resolved once per context.
Discovery parses groups and resources; exec runs over WebSocket channels 0-5.
